name: print-social-lime-black-cream-creative-studio-instagram-template-grid
title: Lime, Black and Cream Studio Template Grid
whatItIs: A dark board with twelve portrait templates for a creative studio in lime, black and cream: intro, story, tagline, coming-soon countdown, we're live, services, reminder, case study, quote, new episode and brief posts, using heavy condensed type on highlight blocks and grayscale photos.
whatItMeans: Neon lime with black and cream feels bold and modern, and grayscale photos let the colour do the talking.
techniques: Heavy condensed caps with lime highlight blocks
Monospace labels with slashes as metadata
Diagonal tape strips reading Coming Soon
bestFor: Creative and design studio social kits

vocabulary.definition: A solid coloured rectangle behind headline words.
A diagonal band of repeated text used as decoration.
Small monospace text used as a technical caption.
